name: Eternal Hunger
blurb: Innate:  Warwick deals bonus magic damage on-hit.

effects.description:
Innate: Warwick deals 6 - 46 (based on level) (+ 15% bonus AD) (+ 10% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit.

While below 50% maximum health, Warwick also heals for 100% of the post-mitigation damage dealt by Eternal Hunger, increased to 250% while below 25% maximum health.

notes:
Eternal Hunger does not affect:
structures
wards (except  effigies),
Jungle plants,
 Gangplank's  kegs
Eternal Hunger does affect:
 Illaoi's  Tentacles [2] (bug)
PENDING FOR TEST: Other units with modified health behaviour.
